harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the C10 native check route end to end: build a real mumei.native-bundle/v1, run `python -m agent native-check` so the pinned identities verify against the trusted-channel build ID, then show a wrong build ID produces no claimed outcome.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_check/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Step 1 runs `native-bundle build` and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the trusted-channel build ID.
Step 2 runs the declared `native-check` route and asserts report.bundle_check == 'consistent' plus the discharged-check partition.
Step 3 reruns the route with a wrong build ID and asserts no claimed outcome and normalized exit_code 1.

name: Declared Native Bundle Check (native-check)
description: C02/C10 check demo: the declared `native-check` route runs `native-bundle check` as one attempt — `bundle_check: consistent` plus the `file_identity` discharged check only on a clean run; a wrong build ID claims no outcome.

narrative.before: The declared route boundary has not yet been checked.
narrative.after: Only the route's declared fields are checked; broader guarantees are not claimed.
narrative.moment: Declared bundle members match; wrong build ID selects nothing.

result_message: Result: Bundle consistency only; wrong pin claims nothing.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Show the declared native-check route checking a real bundle's pinned identities end to end, then refusing to claim an outcome for a wrong build ID.
success_criteria: report.json carries mumei.native-check-report/v1 with bundle_check == 'consistent', discharged_checks == ['file_identity'] and a non-null selected_result
wrong_report.json carries no bundle_check, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1

steps.name: Produce a real native bundle via the Core
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_check/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the declared member set is complete.

steps.name: native-check reports consistent + file_identity
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-check --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_check/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/report.json > {output_dir}/check.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/report.json; cat {output_dir}/check.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-check-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['bundle_check']=='consistent', r; assert r['discharged_checks']==['file_identity']; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is not None; assert 'candidate' not in r; print('native-check: consistent, file_identity discharged')"
steps.artifact_contract: report.json holds mumei.native-check-report/v1 with bundle_check consistent and discharged file_identity.
steps.verifier_gate: native-check exits 0; the pinned identities check consistent against the trusted build ID.

steps.name: Wrong build ID claims no outcome
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-check --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_check/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(python3 -c "import hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'not-the-build-id').hexdigest())") --output {output_dir}/wrong_report.json > {output_dir}/wrong.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/wrong_report.json; cat {output_dir}/wrong.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/wrong_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-check-report/v1'; assert 'bundle_check' not in r; assert 'discharged_checks' not in r; assert r['sequence'].get('selected_result') is None; assert r['normalized'].get('exit_code') == 1, r['normalized']; print('wrong build ID: no claimed outcome, exit 1')"
steps.artifact_contract: wrong_report.json holds no bundle_check, no selected_result and normalized exit_code 1.
steps.verifier_gate: The mismatched build ID exits 1, conflating mismatch with static failure — no claimed outcome.
